subject.title: fix(cron): honor explicit announce delivery on system-event jobs

question: Should an unpinned system-event cron job with a concrete announce-delivery target be implicitly converted into an isolated agent turn, instead of requiring callers to set `sessionTarget: "isolated"` or receiving the current rejection?
rationale: The patch changes the public execution and session boundary between system events and isolated agent turns; tests can validate mechanics but cannot establish whether that behavior is the intended product contract.

options.title: Accept implicit conversion
options.body: Adopt the proposed concrete-target-only conversion and require live delivery proof before merge.

options.title: Keep explicit isolation
options.body: Preserve the current rejection and improve caller guidance so clients must explicitly request an isolated agent-turn job.

recommendation.title: Accept implicit conversion
recommendation.body: Adopt the proposed concrete-target-only conversion and require live delivery proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They can clarify the intended caller workflow and supply the requested live proof, though a current-main cron owner should make the final contract decision.
